reader.decision: Approve the refresh-token purge in change_password, done in a single transaction with the UPDATE, DELETE and new-token insert if db supports it. Do not adopt token_version now.
reader.decision_reason: The message says the 15-minute access token already meets the SR-12 deadline, the purge removes the cause at the cost of one DELETE, and the alternative adds a Redis read per request and breaks the stateless rule. The token_version option is only needed if the requirement drops to seconds.

reconstruction.problem: change_password in api/auth/password.py updates password_hash but leaves all of the user's refresh_tokens rows. refresh_session never checks the password, so a stolen phone keeps renewing its session for 30 days (REFRESH_TTL) after the user changes the password on another device.
reconstruction.what_breaks: SR-12 is violated: other devices are not logged out on password change. A thief keeps access for up to 30 days and can renew it indefinitely. Separately, in the fix, a refresh in flight during the DELETE can insert a new row afterwards, because refresh_session deletes and inserts in separate statements. The window is milliseconds.
reconstruction.fix: In change_password, add db.execute("DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE user_id = %s", user.id) between the UPDATE and issue_tokens. The phone's next refresh then fails with 'invalid refresh token', and access ends at most 15 minutes (ACCESS_TTL) after the change. The laptop gets the new pair and stays logged in. middleware.py is unchanged. Wrap the UPDATE, DELETE and insert in one transaction to close the race, if db supports it.
reconstruction.cost: One extra DELETE statement. No change to middleware, so no Redis or DB read on the 2,500 req/s path. Access stays valid up to 15 minutes, not instant. The transaction depends on db support, which is not stated.

follow_up_questions: Does SR-12 require revocation within 15 minutes, or does it require instant revocation (seconds)? The message says the 15-minute token matches the deadline but does not give the SR-12 text.
Does db support transactions across the UPDATE, DELETE and insert?
reader.closing_answer: I approve the refresh-token purge in change_password. Wrap the UPDATE, DELETE and insert in a transaction if db supports it. Keep token_version in reserve in case SR-12 is tightened to seconds.
